performance.limits: Per-tool preview and commit subcalls are not separately timed by the existing test probe; bridge dispatch is an end-to-end handler round trip. MIR rows include worker process startup/compile/invoke as reported by MirExecutionService. Replay comparison uses Cycle38's documented 24.7 ms median across five/six-operation histories, conservatively normalized by five operations; this is a coarse same-environment baseline rather than an identical semantic workload.

production_bridge.selection_method: first 16 fixed-seed cases, round-robin across seven families
